jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Manager
jobs.description: At Parallel, we build AI agents to help healthcare facilities automate their administrative processes and unlock additional revenue, starting with medical coding. Today, up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost in manual, repetitive administrative work. Legacy software hasn’t helped, it’s made things slower, more complex, and more frustrating for care teams. We believe AI agents can change that. Our technology combines Large Language Models with system-level automation to handle real work inside existing hospital tools. No integrations, no disruption. Our first agent automates coding workflows and frees up time for medical staff to focus on patients. We launched in 2024, are backed by top investors (Index, Frst, Y Combinator, Hexa, Kima Ventures, Better Angle), and we’re just getting started. The future of healthcare isn’t just digital — it’s automated. Come help us build it ! Context This role is open to support an ambitious hiring goal: growing the team by 50%. You will join a team of three recruiters, alongside Léa, our Talent Lead, with whom you will work hand in hand. The priority of the role is hiring tech profiles: Senior Fullstack Engineers, Forward Deployed Engineers and AI Engineers. Your missions Hire the best tech talent Gather hiring needs with Hiring Managers, co-build scorecards, then write and publish job offers. Source active and passive candidates through multiple channels, with a strong focus on headhunting (LinkedIn Recruiter, referrals, events). Assess candidates and run hiring processes end to end in Ashby, through to the offer. Ensure a high-quality candidate experience at every step. Support Hiring Managers Be their point of contact and help them define their team strategy through hiring. Contribute to the recruiting team Contribute, alongside Léa, to improving our hiring processes and our employer brand. You you are : 2 to 4 years of experience in recruiting. Solid headhunting experience, especially on tech profiles, ideally gained in a SaaS

jobs.description: Talent Acquisition Partner / Corporate Recruiter Are you an experienced Corporate Recruiter who enjoys building strong relationships with hiring managers, finding the right talent and continuously improving the recruitment process? Join our HR team in De Lier and help us attract the people who will contribute to Priva’s future. For this position, we are looking for a Dutch-speaking Talent Acquisition Partner who lives within commuting distance of our office in De Lier, the Netherlands. Excellent communication skills in both Dutch and English are required. At Priva, our HR team is close-knit, energetic and ambitious. We believe recruitment is about more than filling vacancies. It is about understanding the business, challenging hiring managers when needed, creating an excellent candidate experience and finding people who truly fit our organization and ambitions. As our new Corporate Recruiter, you will focus primarily on non-technical and commercial vacancies, including roles within account management, customer support, fulfillment and other business functions. You will have the freedom to take ownership of your recruitment portfolio while working closely with hiring managers, HR colleagues and other stakeholders across the organization. Climate for growth Priva develops innovative solutions for horticulture and building automation. Our technology helps customers create smarter, healthier and more sustainable environments while reducing the use of valuable resources such as energy and water. Our ambition is to contribute to a world where people can live and work in healthy, comfortable and sustainable environments. We call this creating a climate for growth. We encourage our employees to take ownership, think entrepreneurially and continuously look for ways to improve. How you add value as a Corporate Recruiter As a Corporate Recruiter, you are a strategic recruitment partner for your hiring managers and responsible for the full recruitment lifecycle of the vacancies

jobs.title: Senior HR advisor / Senior HR Adviseur
jobs.description: Maak impact op HR, organisatie en medewerkers Wil jij als Senior HR Advisor complexe HR-vraagstukken vertalen naar praktisch en toekomstgericht HR-beleid? En krijg je energie van adviseren, verbeteren én zelf de handen uit de mouwen steken? Bij Priva werk je nauw samen met onze HR Business Partners, HR Director en HR Operations-collega's. Je bent een ervaren sparringpartner voor het HR-team en de business en draagt bij aan complexe HR-casuïstiek, organisatieontwikkeling en strategische HR-projecten. Je combineert een brede HR-expertise met een praktische aanpak. Van arbeidsrecht en verzuim tot HR-processen, beleid, data en systemen: jij weet wat er nodig is om onze HR-dienstverlening continu te verbeteren. Wat ga je doen? Als Senior HR Advisor : adviseer je over complexe HR-vraagstukken, arbeidsrecht, verzuim, arbeidsvoorwaarden en organisatieveranderingen; ondersteun je HR Business Partners en management bij individuele en collectieve HR-casuïstiek; draag je bij aan strategische HR-projecten rondom onder andere cultuur, organisatieontwikkeling, transformatie en HR-beleid; vertaal je HR-strategie en wet- en regelgeving naar duidelijke en werkbare processen en oplossingen; werk je samen met HR Operations aan een professionele en efficiënte HR-dienstverlening; analyseer en verbeter je HR-processen en systemen; zet je HR-data en technologie in om betere beslissingen en procesverbeteringen mogelijk te maken; werk je actief met HR-systemen zoals AFAS en kijk je verder dan alleen de gebruikerskant om processen slimmer in te richten. Wie ben jij? Je bent een ervaren HR-professional die gemakkelijk schakelt tussen strategie, advies en uitvoering. Je hebt een stevige inhoudelijke HR-basis, maar kijkt tegelijkertijd verder: waar kunnen processen beter, welke impact heeft een verandering op de organisatie en wat hebben managers en medewerkers nodig? Je bent kritisch wanneer dat nodig is, praktisch wanneer het kan en weet verschillende stakeholders mee te nemen in veranderingen

jobs.title: Founding Recruiter (m/f/x)
jobs.description: 01 · Why this role exists Invest in Values. Produce in Freedom. Boost Europe. Behind every megawatt hour our clients save, there are people who make it happen. RIZM helps Europe's largest industrial companies – together around 2% of Europe's total energy demand – make their energy decisions with AI. Our agent RIZMO works as a digital colleague. But the most important colleagues are the ones we haven't found yet. That's your job. We're about 15 people today and growing fast. There is no recruiting playbook yet, no big HR department and no "that's how we've always done it". You'll write the playbook. Not as application admin, but as the person who shapes who RIZM becomes. 02 · Hi, we're Diana and Josh – we'll be working together I'm Diana, 20, I study civil engineering in Münster and I currently run recruiting at RIZM on my own, 20 hours a week. That's not enough for what's ahead of us, which is why we're looking for you. You'll be in our Munich office – I'm based in Münster and will come over regularly. Josh, our co-founder & CBO, comes from statistics and risk management and will be your sparring partner whenever you need one – for tricky candidates, for offers and for figuring out who we need next. 03 · What you'll do Build the team of tomorrow: Design our recruiting from scratch – roles, workflows, tools – and later bring more recruiters and sourcers on board yourself. Find the right people: Track down engineers, energy experts and product people via LinkedIn, Juicebox, universities, communities and your own network. jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Manager (all genders)
jobs.description: Unterstütze uns dabei, das Versicherungserlebnis der Zukunft aktiv mitzugestalten! Als Talent Acquisition Manager (all genders) spielst du eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Gewinnung von Top-Talenten, während sich getolo vom Start-up zum Scale-up weiterentwickelt. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf dem gesamten Recruiting-Prozess für unsere Sales- und Operations-Teams. Die Position ist in Vollzeit (40 Stunden pro Woche) und im hybriden Arbeitsmodell zu besetzen. Du arbeitest 1–2 Tage pro Woche in unserem Berliner Büro. Voraussetzung sind verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse. Deine Mission Du verantwortest den gesamten Recruiting-Prozess – von der Kandidatensuche über die Vorauswahl und Interviews bis hin zur Einstellung. jobs.description:
$100,000 - $120,000 a year Akicita Federal, LLC is a growing 8(a) small business that delivers healthcare, professional, and administrative services to federal agencies. We're adding a contracts manager to help us grow beyond our current work. The job is to find opportunities, write winning proposals quickly, and build lasting relationships with agencies and teaming partners.
